spans.s: लेख n. 1. A writing, a letter, a written document of any kind, अनंगलेखक्रिययोपयोगम् K.S.i.7, निर्धारितेर्थे लेखेन खलूक्त्वा खलु वाचिकम् Sis.ii.70; 2. a god, a deity.

लेखा f. 1. A streak, a line, आर्द्रारुणगंडलेखाम् K.S.vii.82, 16, i.47, R.viii.42, Megh.i.44; 2. a stroke, a farrow, a row; 3. writing; 4. drawing, painting, पाणिर्लेखाविधिषु नितरां वर्तते किं करोमि M.M.i.; 5. a likeness, an impression, सयावकसव्यपादलेखा Kir.v.40; 6. hem, border; 7. the moon’s crescent, अमलयतीह वनांतमिंदुलेखा Kir.v.44.
लेख-अधिकारिन् m. the secretary of a king.
लेख-अर्ह m. a kind of palm tree.
लेख-ऋषभ m. an epithet of Indra.
लेख-पत्र n. 1. a writing, an epistle; 2. a deed, a document.
लेख-पत्रिका f. 1. a writing, an epistle; 2. a deed, a document.
लेख-हार, -हारक m. a letter-carrier.
लेख-हार, -हारक m. a letter-carrier.
लेखक m. 1. A writer, a scribe; 2. a painter.
लेखक-प्रमाद m. an error of a scrile.
लेखन (I) m. A sort of reed of which pens are made.
लेखन (II) n. 1. Scratching, scraping; 2. writing, transcribing; 3. attenuating, making thin; 4. the leaf of the palm tree used for writing on.
लेखन-साधन n. writing materials.
लेखनिक m. A letter-carrier.
लेख(खि)नी f. 1. A pen, a writing-reed; 2. a spoon.
लेख(खि)नी f. 1. A pen, a writing-reed; 2. a spoon.
लेख्य n. 1. Writing, transcribing; 2. a writing, a letter, a manuscript; 3. an inscription; 4. the art of writing; 5. painting, drawing; 6. a painted figure.
लेख्य-आरूढ a. committed to writing.
लेख्य-गत a. represented in painting.
लेख्य-चूर्णिका f. a painted brush.
लेख्य-पत्र, -पत्रक n. 1. a document, a letter; 2. a palm leaf for writing on.
लेख्य-पत्र, -पत्रक n. 1. a document, a letter; 2. a palm leaf for writing on.
लेख्य-स्थान n. a writing place.
